label: Canon imageRUNNER 1643i
description: Canon imageRUNNER 1643i is a 43 ppm A4 monochrome laser multifunction - print, copy, scan and send - with a 12.7 cm colour touch panel, duplex printing, 1.0 GB RAM and UFR II/PCL/PostScript page languages. Standard network is one RJ45 1000Base-T/100Base-TX/10Base-T port plus a 2.4 GHz 802.11b/g/n radio with Wi-Fi Direct; the i variant has no fax board and no NFC, and there is no PoE.
notes: From Canon Europe's specification page: Interface Connection - NETWORK Standard '1000Base-T/100Base-TX/10-Base-T, Wireless LAN (IEEE 802.11 b/g/n), NFC (iR 1643iF only), Wi-Fi Direct Connection'; OTHERS Standard 'USB 2.0 (Host) x2, USB 2.0 (Device) x1' (not modelled); print speed 43 ppm A4; 1.0 GB RAM; UFR II, PCL6, PCL5, Adobe PostScript 3. Core functions differ by suffix: the 1643i is print/copy/scan/send, the 1643iF adds fax and NFC - use the iF if a lab needs the POTS line. Not confirmed: Canon publishes no radio PHY rate, so 300M is the 802.11n 2.4 GHz ceiling used as the model figure. No PoE.
